projects.name: Agent Identity Protocol
projects.description: Verifiable delegation protocol for AI agent systems. Introduces Invocation-Bound Capability Tokens with compact (JWT) and chained (Biscuit with Datalog) wire formats, with Python and Rust reference implementations.

projects.name: APort
projects.description: Passport-based authorization for AI agents. Attaches verifiable permissions to agent identities, with a pre-action authorization and suspension model. Integrates with major agent frameworks.

projects.name: Agent Passport System
projects.description: Cryptographic identity, scoped delegation, governance, and commerce protocol for AI agents. Ed25519 signatures, offline-verifiable, 23 v2 constitutional modules across identity, delegation, enforcement, data lifecycle, accountability, and coordination. Reference implementations in TypeScript, Python, and Go with cross-language byte-parity verified across the full Wave 1 surface.

_github.description: Cryptographic identity, delegation, governance, and commerce protocol for AI agents. Ed25519 signatures, 107 protocol modules, 2966 tests. npm install agent-passport-system

projects.name: Delegated Agent Authorization Protocol
projects.description: Open, model-neutral protocol for cryptographic agent identity using DIDs, a human-consent grant flow modelled on OAuth 2.0, signed JWT grant tokens, and a policy engine with OPA and Cedar integration.

relates_to.note: Independent convergence on delegation invariants; external policy engine binding.

projects.name: ERC-8004 Trustless Agents
projects.description: Ethereum standard extending the Agent-to-Agent protocol with three lightweight on-chain registries for agent identity, reputation, and validation. Mainnet-live since January 2026.

relates_to.note: Blockchain-based trust layer on top of A2A.

_github.description: Registry contracts curated by the 8004 team

projects.name: Human Delegation Provenance
projects.description: Lightweight cryptographic protocol for human delegation provenance in agentic AI. Token-based scheme with append-only hop chain, fully offline verification using only the issuer's Ed25519 public key and session identifier.

relates_to.note: Closest technical cousin on offline-verifiable signed delegation chains.

_github.description: Human Delegation Provenance Protocol - cryptographic chain-of-custody for agentic AI

A public, federated registry of trusted attestation issuers — the agent runtimes authorized to vouch for agents acting on behalf of humans.
